email.subject1: a signal play for Rev.io PSA
email.body1:
Jay, saw Rev.io launched its next-gen PSA platform and just took a 2026 MSP Today Product of the Year award.

A platform launch plus award recognition usually means more MSPs evaluating you than the team can reach before interest cools, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Rev.io PSA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jay, quick follow-up for Rev.io PSA.

When a new platform drives demand, most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Rev.io PSA needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jay, last bit of proof for Rev.io PSA.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rev.io PSA's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jay, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and I know a platform launch keeps you busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an MSP motion? I will tailor it to Rev.io PSA either way.
